card.name: Lipid thresholds before mg/dL
card.fires_on: The digit or symbol just before a number and mg/dL in cholesterol and triglyceride cutoffs, such as 200, 500, 800 or 40. It also fires on the < or ≥ sign that opens these ranges.

modes.label: Digits in triglyceride cutoffs
modes.description: The first digit of a threshold value, shortly before 00 mg/dL, in triglyceride shift tables or text.

modes.label: Range symbols in lipid tables
modes.description: A < or ≥ sign or a space before a lipid cutoff number in normal-to-high or normal-to-low rows.
